etsy.title: Hockey Goalie Butterfly Definition Poster, Funny Goalie Print, Hockey Wall Art, Gift for Goalies
etsy.description:
A funny hockey goalie poster that defines the butterfly as what it really is: a desperate floor dive dressed as technique.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a locker room, garage, game room, or goalie's bedroom.

This listing is a physical poster print. Generic design: no league, team, or club marks. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Hockey goalie prints on Etsy are mostly personalized watercolor or silhouette art; few use slang definitions.
A t-shirt listing uses the phrase 'It's Butterfly Season' for goalies but no poster equivalent exists.
A graphic design uses 'Drop like a butterfly, block like a beast' on merchandise.
Amazon goalie posters are mostly motivational quotes, personalized name prints, and pro player art.
A vintage 1948 patent print of an ice hockey goalkeeper is available for a retro look.

research.notes: The butterfly is iconic goalie technique but no competing definition-humor poster exists. This fills a gap for goalie-specific funny wall art.
